description: Source code for MD5-HMAC cryptographic driver for Linux kernel, implementing hashing and HMAC functions with hardware acceleration support.

methods.name: md5_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, handles workaround for DBN size.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets MD5 HMAC key, supports keys longer than 64 bytes by hashing.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: md5_hmac_update
methods.description: Performs on-the-fly MD5 HMAC computation with input data.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 HMAC computation, calls final implementation.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Computes final or intermediate MD5 HMAC value, interacts with hardware hash engine.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init_tfm
methods.description: Initializes pointers in MD5 HMAC context.

methods.name: md5_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees resources in MD5 HMAC context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5_hmac
methods.description: Registers MD5 HMAC driver with kernel crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5_hmac
methods.description: Unregisters MD5 HMAC driver from kernel crypto API.
